name: Nametag
description: Nametag is a personal CRM for the people in your life. Keep notes, birthdays and important dates, see how everyone is connected in an interactive network graph, organize people into groups, keep a journal, and get reminders to stay in touch. Two-way CardDAV sync works with Google Contacts, iCloud, Outlook and Nextcloud. Before the first start: - Install a PostgreSQL container (for example the official postgres:16 image) and create a database and user for Nametag. - Generate the two secrets in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -base64 32 - Run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/nametag/photos && chown -R 1001:1001 /mnt/user/appdata/nametag (the container runs as UID 1001). Reminders and CardDAV sync need scheduled calls. The Read Me link has ready-to-paste User Scripts entries.

paths.name: Photos
paths.description: Where profile photos are stored. Must be owned by UID 1001.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: The address you open Nametag at, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://nametag.example.com. Used for sign-in and links in emails.

variables.name: Auth secret
variables.description: At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Cron secret
variables.description: At least 16 characters. Protects the scheduled-job endpoints. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: IP address or container name of your PostgreSQL server.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database. It must already exist.

variables.name: Disable registration
variables.description: Set to true after creating your account to stop others from signing up.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional. For example redis://192.168.1.10:6379. Without it, rate limiting uses memory.

variables.name: Redis password
variables.description: Optional. Only if your Redis needs a password.

variables.name: Email domain
variables.description: Domain emails are sent from, for example example.com. Needed to send email.

variables.name: SMTP host
variables.description: Optional. SMTP server for reminder and password-reset emails.

variables.name: SMTP secure
variables.description: true for port 465, false for 587. Default false.

variables.name: SMTP user
variables.description: SMTP username, often your email address.

variables.name: SMTP from
variables.description: Optional. Override the from address if your server rejects custom ones.
